import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path


def _run(cmd, cwd='/app', timeout=180):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout, check=False)


def _watchdog_payload(output):
    for line in output.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('BOOTSTRAP_WATCHDOG='):
            return json.loads(line.split('=', 1)[1])
    raise AssertionError('WATCHDOG_PAYLOAD_MISSING\n' + output[-3000:])


def test_preview_safe_fast_forward_and_backend_reload():
    env_name = str(os.getenv('EDARSA_ENV') or os.getenv('APP_ENV') or os.getenv('ENVIRONMENT') or 'PREVIEW').upper()
    assert 'PROD' not in env_name, f'PRODUCTION_ENV_BLOCKED:{env_name}'

    wd = _run([sys.executable, '/app/tools/bootstrap/edarsahub_bootstrap_watchdog.py', '--once'], timeout=240)
    assert wd.returncode == 0, 'WATCHDOG_EXECUTION_FAILED\n' + wd.stdout[-4000:]
    payload = _watchdog_payload(wd.stdout)
    state = (payload.get('ff') or {}).get('state')
    assert state in {'FF_APPLIED', 'ALIGNED'}, f'WATCHDOG_DID_NOT_CONVERGE:{state}:{payload}'

    local = _run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], timeout=30)
    remote = _run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'origin/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'], timeout=30)
    assert local.returncode == 0 and remote.returncode == 0
    assert local.stdout.strip() == remote.stdout.strip(), f'PREVIEW_HEAD_STALE:{local.stdout.strip()}!={remote.stdout.strip()}'

    route = Path('/app/backend/modules/inteligencia_comercial/iscam_routes.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    block = route.split('@iscam_router.get(\"/ventas-periodos\")', 1)[1].split('@iscam_router.get(\"/ventas-periodos/productos\")', 1)[0]
    assert 'dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime' in block
    assert 'dbo.Sync_Sales' not in block

    restart = _run(['supervisorctl', 'restart', 'backend'], timeout=60)
    assert restart.returncode == 0, 'BACKEND_RESTART_FAILED\n' + restart.stdout[-2000:]
    time.sleep(4)
    status = _run(['supervisorctl', 'status', 'backend'], timeout=30)
    assert status.returncode == 0
    assert ('RUNNING' in status.stdout or 'STARTING' in status.stdout), 'BACKEND_NOT_HEALTHY\n' + status.stdout[-2000:]
